reply.text:
I'm sorry your shoulders are aching. That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't judge what it is or how to treat it. Please get it looked at before you load them further, and let them clear what training is safe.

Once they've signed off, I'm glad to build you a lighter push day around whatever they tell you to avoid. Tell me what they say, and I'll set it up with you.
